name: Google Digital Skills for Africa
bestFor: Beginners, jobseekers and small business owners
freeDetails: Free digital marketing and online business learning from Google.
requirements: Google account may be needed for progress tracking and certificates.
watchOut: Check the course page before promising a certificate because course availability can change.

name: Microsoft Learn South Africa
bestFor: Students, IT beginners and people building technical skills
freeDetails: Free learning paths, product training and selected virtual training events from Microsoft.
requirements: Microsoft account is useful for saving progress; some certifications or exams may cost money.
watchOut: Free learning content is not always the same as a free certification exam.

name: Vodacom Digital Skills Hub
bestFor: Young people and jobseekers looking for digital skills
freeDetails: Free digital-skills courses, with some learning routes promoted as zero-rated for Vodacom users.
requirements: Registration is usually required; data benefits may depend on network and current programme rules.
watchOut: Confirm the current course catalogue and any zero-rated data wording on Vodacom's own page.

name: Book Dash
bestFor: Parents, teachers, libraries and reading clubs
freeDetails: Free African children's picture books that can be read, downloaded, printed and shared under an open model.
requirements: No purchase needed for digital books; printing or data may still have normal user costs.
watchOut: Use the official Book Dash library rather than third-party download mirrors.

name: Nal'ibali
bestFor: Families, teachers and caregivers of children aged 0-12
freeDetails: Free stories, audio stories, printables and reading resources in South African languages.
requirements: No purchase needed for online resources; downloads and printing may use data or paper.
watchOut: Choose the language and age level that fits the child instead of downloading random PDFs.

name: FunDza
bestFor: Teens, young adults and mobile readers
freeDetails: Mobile-friendly South African stories, reading content and literacy resources.
requirements: Works best online or on mobile; account features may vary by current platform setup.
watchOut: It is stronger for teen and young-adult reading than preschool picture books.

name: Experian South Africa
bestFor: Consumers checking their credit report and score
freeDetails: Free access to Experian personal credit report and credit score through Experian's consumer platform.
requirements: Valid South African ID details and identity verification are expected.
watchOut: Use Experian's official site and never share banking passwords or card PINs.

name: TransUnion South Africa
bestFor: Consumers using their free annual bureau report right
freeDetails: Free annual credit report access from TransUnion South Africa.
requirements: Identity verification is required before report access.
watchOut: A free credit report is not the same as guaranteed credit approval.
manualOkReason: Official credit-bureau site can return automated-check 403 responses.
manualOkEvidence: Official TransUnion South Africa annual free credit report page was manually rechecked on 2026-07-27 and still states that consumers can access their TransUnion credit report once a year for free.

name: ClearScore South Africa
bestFor: Consumers who want ongoing score and report visibility
freeDetails: Free credit score and report access, with personalised financial offers shown separately.
requirements: Sign-up and identity checks are required.
watchOut: Treat loan and credit offers as advertising or eligibility guidance, not approval.
manualOkReason: Official site can return automated-check 403 responses.
manualOkEvidence: Official ClearScore South Africa page was manually rechecked on 2026-07-27 and still advertises a free South African credit score and report with no credit-card trial requirement.

name: Brand Advisor
bestFor: Consumers interested in product testing and honest feedback
freeDetails: Product exchange and trial opportunities may be available when campaigns are open.
requirements: Application, profile details and content or feedback may be required.
watchOut: Campaigns are limited and not every application gets selected.

name: Review Club South Africa
bestFor: Creators and shoppers who can review products honestly
freeDetails: Free product campaigns may be offered to selected users in exchange for feedback or content.
requirements: Profile setup, campaign application and review/content tasks may apply.
watchOut: Check whether a campaign is active before signing up; availability can be limited.
manualOkReason: Official site may reject automated link-check requests.
manualOkEvidence: Official Review Club South Africa how-it-works page was manually rechecked on 2026-07-14 for free creator product campaign and product-testing programme context.

name: ReviewClub international product tests
bestFor: Users comparing how product-testing panels usually work
freeDetails: Explains product testing in exchange for honest feedback, reviews or surveys.
requirements: Selection, testing periods and feedback tasks vary by campaign.
watchOut: Use this as an international product-testing explainer, not a South African offer. Some tested products must be returned or purchased after testing.

name: Home Tester Club South Africa
bestFor: Shoppers who want to apply for product tests and share feedback
freeDetails: Members can view and register for product tests that are open for registration when suitable campaigns are available.
requirements: Sign-in, profile details and qualifying questions may be required before selection.
watchOut: Product-test places are limited and registration does not guarantee selection.

name: Try and Review South Africa
bestFor: Consumers interested in applying for home product trials
freeDetails: Selected product testers may receive products to try at home and review through the official Try and Review platform.
requirements: Account registration, campaign application and honest review feedback may be required.
watchOut: Check each product test carefully because availability, eligibility and delivery details can change by campaign.

name: Coloplast South Africa Samples
bestFor: People who need ostomy, continence or wound-care product samples
freeDetails: Official Coloplast South Africa sampling site with product information and sample-request routes for relevant medical product categories.
requirements: Registration, product-category details and personal or care-related information may be required.
watchOut: This is a niche healthcare sample route, not a general freebie site. Use the official Coloplast page and avoid sharing sensitive medical details with third-party copies.
manualOkReason: Official Coloplast South Africa sampling site returns HTTP 403 to the Freehub link checker but was manually rechecked in a browser-style request.
manualOkEvidence: Official Coloplast ZA sampling site was manually rechecked on 2026-07-14. The page identifies South Africa as the country, has category Sampling Site, and includes product and sample-request navigation for ostomy, continence and wound-care products.

name: Kalley free flooring samples
bestFor: Homeowners and renovators comparing flooring before buying
freeDetails: Kalley offers the flooring sample pieces at no product charge before you choose a floor.
requirements: Sample choices, contact details and delivery information are required. Kalley currently states a R69 shipping charge for delivery.
watchOut: The samples are not completely free once delivery is included. Confirm the current R69 shipping charge and service area on Kalley's official site before requesting.

name: National Consumer Commission complaints portal
bestFor: Consumers who need an official complaint route under the Consumer Protection Act
freeDetails: Official National Consumer Commission information and complaint route for eligible consumer complaints.
requirements: A registered e-Services profile, complaint details and supporting proof may be required.
watchOut: This is not a giveaway. Use it for consumer-rights support and keep copies of complaint references and evidence.

name: Free basic municipal services
bestFor: Low-income households checking whether they qualify for municipal indigent support
freeDetails: Government guidance on free basic water, electricity, sanitation or other municipal support for qualifying households.
requirements: Usually means-tested through the local municipality; extra usage can still be billed.
watchOut: Rules differ by municipality, so confirm eligibility, documents and limits with your own local municipality.
manualOkReason: Official gov.za municipal-services page can time out during automated link checks.
manualOkEvidence: Official gov.za municipal-services guidance was manually rechecked on 2026-07-31. It confirms minimum free basic electricity, water and sanitation for qualifying poor households, notes that availability differs by municipality and directs applicants to their local municipality.

name: Krispy Kreme South Africa app registration reward
bestFor: First-time Krispy Kreme South Africa app users who can redeem in a full Krispy Kreme shop
freeDetails: New app users receive one Original Glazed doughnut after first registration, with no food purchase required for that registration reward.
requirements: First-time app registration is required. The reward appears after 48 hours, lasts one month and is redeemable only in participating on-premise Krispy Kreme shops.
watchOut: This is not valid through delivery, online orders or Doughnuts on the Go locations. The separate birthday dozen requires buying a dozen and is not a strict freebie.

name: Western Cape Jobseeker Travel Voucher Programme
bestFor: Unemployed jobseekers in Cape Town and George who need transport to look for work
freeDetails: Qualifying registered jobseekers receive a once-off voucher with six free off-peak trips on Golden Arrow in Cape Town or GO GEORGE in George.
requirements: You must be unemployed, have a valid South African ID, register on the Getting YOU to Work portal and collect the card from a participating kiosk or vendor.
watchOut: The voucher is location-limited and can be used Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 15:00. Replacement cards may cost money.

name: Mediclinic Baby Programme
bestFor: Expecting parents looking for South African pregnancy and newborn information and support
freeDetails: Free registration provides access to pregnancy and baby information, newsletters, webinars, virtual conferences and a helpline, including for people not delivering at Mediclinic.
requirements: Online registration and personal or pregnancy-related details are required. Some bonus benefits apply only to members delivering at a Mediclinic facility.
watchOut: This is an information and support programme, not a physical baby-sample pack. Medical questions should still be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.

name: Absa Advantage meal vouchers
bestFor: Adult Absa Personal Banking clients who use the latest Absa Banking App and receive an Advantage challenge
freeDetails: Absa Advantage offers meal vouchers for completing eligible in-app banking challenges. The official programme page says the vouchers have no minimum spend and can be shared with friends or family.
requirements: Be a South African citizen or resident aged 18 or older, use the latest Absa Banking App for personal banking, keep the qualifying account in good standing, enable NotifyMe, and accept and complete the displayed challenge within its deadline.
watchOut: Challenges differ between clients. After a successful challenge, the official terms allow five calendar days to select a reward and 14 calendar days to use the voucher. Restaurant choice, voucher value and regional availability can vary.

name: Kauai app birthday reward
bestFor: South African adults who use the Kauai App and complete their date of birth before their birthday
freeDetails: Kauai lists an annual tier-based birthday reward: Green members get any small smoothie, Gold members get any wrap, and Black members get any meal plus any small smoothie.
requirements: Kauai App registration is required for South African citizens aged 18 or older. Complete the profile and date of birth and link a valid payment card; the terms state that a temporary R1 card-verification deduction is reversed.
watchOut: The public terms do not state the birthday reward's redemption window. Check the validity shown in My Vouchers before travelling. Participating-store and product exclusions apply.

name: Spur R50 birthday voucher
bestFor: Registered Spur Family members who already spend regularly at Spur
freeDetails: A registered member who spent at least R1,000 at Spur in the 12 months before their birthday receives a R50 birthday voucher in their profile on the birthday.
requirements: Register a Spur Family profile in the app and reach R1,000 cumulative qualifying Spur spend during the 12 months before the birthday.
watchOut: This is a spend-linked loyalty voucher, not a no-purchase freebie. It is valid for 31 days, is non-transferable and can only be used by the registered member under the current redemption rules.
manualOkReason: The current App Terms route linked from Spur's official Legal page returns HTTP 403 to the automated checker but opens in a real browser and redirects to Spur's live terms PDF.
manualOkEvidence: Spur's official Legal page and current App Terms route were rechecked on 2026-07-31. The linked terms state the R1,000 prior-spend threshold, R50 birthday voucher, profile loading on the birthday, 31-day validity and non-transferability.

name: Bootlegger app registration coffee
bestFor: New Bootlegger Coffee Company app users near a participating cafe
freeDetails: Bootlegger's official loyalty-app guide states that new users receive a free coffee on registration.
requirements: Download the Bootlegger app, create a new account and redeem the registration reward under the current in-app conditions.
watchOut: Check the reward's product choice, validity period and participating cafe availability in the app before travelling. The separate stamp reward requires ten purchases.

name: Telkom R550 customer referral credit
bestFor: Existing Telkom customers with an active fixed or mobile service who know someone considering a new Telkom fibre contract
freeDetails: Telkom's current customer-referral terms offer the referrer R550 account credit after a successful referred order is put into service.
requirements: The referrer must be an existing Telkom customer with an active fixed or mobile service. Referrals are limited to friends or family, up to 30 contacts per day, and the referred person must not already have an active Telkom fibre service.
watchOut: This is Telkom account credit, not cash, a prize draw or a public publisher-affiliate programme. The referred person takes out a paid fibre contract and may face early-termination penalties. Mo'Nice is a separate personalised prepaid promotion, not part of this referral reward.
